posts.bodyHtml:
Hey My name is William aka BK


0) Do I meet the requirements?
Yes i do, i have been admin on multiple other knife servers, but they have been closed down, im a very calm and a nice admin,
im a rule guy so dont worry about that, and i can handle that im going to have a important rank and dont take abuse of my powers
even if my friends tells me to.
1) What is your name? Real & Ingame
My real name is William, and ingame name BK
2) How old are you?
I'm 15, years old.
3) Why do you want to join our administrative team?
I want to join the admin team to stop rule breakers, mic spammers, auto knifers (quite annoying people) and Call Admin Abusers, And i also want to help the server to get less mic spammers & Auto-Knifers, & Many people
delay and just run around wich ruins the fun in playing knife, you loose the "feeling", And then we have the 2v1'ers wich are quite annoying to meet, i have meet alot of Mic spammers, and Auto Knifers, & 2v1'ers on dream,
and i cant stop it, cause im not an admin, and it takes almost 30 minutes until a admin is playing, and if i was admin, i would be there all the time, Im a guy that is online alot, and enyoys knife very much.
4) How long have you been playing on our servers?
I have played with many diffrent accounts, but i have played a few months, in total like 6000 Minutes, And I was pretty known on other accounts.
5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes?
My Hobbies is to bicycle in the mountains, but i dont do that often, other than that its the computer,
wich is fun, cause right after school, its dream time, and i also play football some time to time.
6) Do you think of yourself as mature?
Yes, I consider myself as mature, i dont act childish either do i swear, and act like a jerk,
I just enyoy playing, and i have never been "not mature" cause im a very calm person as
i mentioned higher up.
7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before?
Yes, I have been admin on multiple Knife servers that have been closed down,
and i was also an head-admin once in a time, and yes i have experience in admin commands, such as !admin, and alot
of the other stuff you can do with admin perms.




Monday Tuesday Wednesday Thursday Friday Saturday Sunday 13-23 13-24 13-01:30 14-23:30 12-01:30 10-02:30 13-23


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?


If i knew them, i would allow them to an exessive amount, but i wold warn User1 of his act/behaviour, but if they still carried on to insult, i would just mute the guy that was throwing insults, to the end of the map that is played,
But, If he still carries on after map change, i would kick him for abusive used language, and if he comes back and insults me or user2, i would ban him minimum 30 min, I would also take to consideration if he had previous bans for the same reason, but if i was not on the server, and i got like called in, i would mute the first user (user1), and talk/interview user2, wich later then i would mute user 2 and unmute user 1 and talk to him about the situation too, And then at the end i would ask the dream "community" for their thoughts / experience and what was going on, on the server, if user 1 & 2 were abusive at that moment, wich then i would make the reasonable decision of possible banning one of them user1 or user2.


10) Strengths
- Maturity has never been a problem.
- Kind Person, But very understanding.
- Im Calm.
- Easily approached
- Respectful
- I listen to everyone's word and what they got to say to me
11) Weaknesses
- My weaknesses are probaly when i get upset, or someone insult me.
- Or when i get upset and i speak too fast and my english gets a bit broken cause im swedish.
12) Conclusion / Closing remark
Thank you for reading my application, I really appriciate it, and i hope
atleast i can make it to Test Admin, Good bye folks at Dream Communtiy [<3] [<3]




Bye Bye! ~BK 😄
